title: ChromaDB crash on NTFS WSL mounts
problem: ChromaDB SQLite backend fails on NTFS-mounted WSL paths.
fix: Move DB to ext4 filesystem: mv ~/.chromadb /mnt/ext4/

title: WSL terminal underscore corruption under high load
problem: WSL terminal paste swallows underscores under high load.
fix: Use tmux or pipe stdin via temp script files.

title: MCP stdio pipe timeout with large payloads
problem: MCP client times out waiting for stdio responses >64KB.
fix: Stream responses or increase buffer size in adapter.
